source: Israel Planning Administration + Government Urban Renewal Authority, via mitar.co.il
attribution: מתאר (mitar.co.il), על בסיס נתוני הרשות הממשלתית להתחדשות עירונית (משרד הבינוי והשיכון) ומנהל התכנון

source_licenses.name: הרשות הממשלתית להתחדשות עירונית, שכבת המתחמים המוכרזים (ArcGIS, משרד הבינוי והשיכון)
הרשות הממשלתית להתחדשות עירונית / משרד הבינוי והשיכון, טבלת המתחמים ב-data.gov.il

not_official_he: מדד הרשויות הוא עיבוד של מתאר לנתונים ממשלתיים פתוחים. הוא אינו פרסום רשמי, ואינו נעשה מטעם המדינה, הרשות הממשלתית להתחדשות עירונית או מנהל התכנון, או בחסותם.
totals_note_he: נכון ל-2026-11-18: 1,304 רשומות ממשלתיות בערים שבקובץ, מתוך 1,624 במאגר. ההפרש, 320: 274 דיווחים מפרסומים, שאינם נספרים במדד; 24 כפילויות שסומנו; 21 מתחמים שהרשות הסירה משכבת המתחמים; שורה אחת ביישוב שאינו במדד.
changelog: 2026-11-18-c: the median sample, the district-committee count and the years count each plan (normalised plan_name) once per city; source_licenses and not_official_he added.

2026-11-18-b: approved also counts the Authority's own 'approved plan' status (codeStatusHarashut 3 or 4); compounds the Authority removed from its layer (source_missing_since) are no longer counted in projects_total or units, but their plans stay in the median sample.

2026-11-18: the weighted score and the ranking were removed. Each measure is published on its own with its sample: Authority track approved/total (percentage only from 5 complexes), tax track approved/total (no percentage), median deposit-to-approval days (only from 10 plans) with the years and the district-committee count. Duplicate rows are counted once.
tracks_basis: Declared: the Urban Renewal Authority's map layer (TeurSugMaslul), split into the Authority track (רשויות) and the tax track (מיסוי). Approved: Xplan gazette publication, or the Authority's approval date (taarichTokef) or 'approved plan' status (codeStatusHarashut 3 or 4). In the tax track the declaration often follows the plan's approval, so its approval share is not a measure of the authority's pace. Government records only.

cities.name: ירושלים
cities.projects_in_execution_basis: The Urban Renewal Authority's Bebitzua flag. It is set only while permits cover part of a complex's units; a complex with permits for every unit is not marked, so it is not a completion rate.
cities.units_basis: registry rows only; reports read off publications are not summed
cities.median_deposit_to_approval_basis: Plans with both a deposit date (Xplan pl_date_advertise) and a gazette approval date (pl_date_8). Xplan fills the deposit date for most district-committee plans and almost no local-committee plans, so this is mostly the district-committee track. approved_without_deposit counts the approved plans it leaves out.
cities.authority_track_decl_basis: Over the complexes in authority_track_total: earliest/latest year of declaration_date, how many have declaration_date within the last two years, and how many have none (left out of the years).

cities.median_deposit_to_approval_basis: Plans with both a deposit date (Xplan pl_date_advertise) and a gazette approval date (pl_date_8). Xplan fills the deposit date for most district-committee plans and almost no local-committee plans, so this is mostly the district-committee track. approved_without_deposit counts the approved plans it leaves out.
cities.authority_track_decl_basis: Over the complexes in authority_track_total: earliest/latest year of declaration_date, how many have declaration_date within the last two years, and how many have none (left out of the years).
